topic.angle: A coffee pot at Cambridge, so researchers did not walk to an empty pot

card.title: The first webcam watched a coffee pot

panels.text: Cambridge, 1991. Researchers in the Computer Laboratory share one coffee pot. Walking over only to find it empty is a wasted trip.
So they point a camera at the pot and write software that sends a small, grainy picture of it to everyone's screen.
In 1993 the picture goes onto the World Wide Web, and people can watch the pot online. It is often called the first webcam.
The twist: a Krups coffee machine it watched was later auctioned on eBay for £3,350, as reported by Der Spiegel.

probes.question: What did the first webcam famously point at?
True or false: the Trojan Room coffee pot camera was first set up so researchers could see if the pot was empty.
